_note: The class SL-104 closes, as a table (O-031, SL-056 review R2-m4 and SL-104 review M1 and M2). Two families of spellings were found one at a time and a pattern was written for each: (1) compound-assignment spellings of a fenced property setter (a time, Attributes, IsReadOnly; the operators =, +=, -=, |=, &=, ^=, as many as the property type has), and (2) static-versus-instance-versus-alias spellings of one BCL operation (File and Directory statics, FileInfo and DirectoryInfo instances, a method group, using static, a fully qualified name, the Win32 and NT names with the Zw alias, an object initializer). Each row is a line or lines of C#; expect is fire (the named rule must match it), quiet (it must not) or residual (a known false negative of a text rule, named in the rule's because-text: it must stay unmatched, and a row that starts to match must be reclassified to fire and struck from the because-text). The census lists every public member of File, Directory, FileInfo, DirectoryInfo and FileSystemInfo, as of .NET 10, that writes a time or an attribute, encrypts or decrypts, or lists a directory, with one sample line each. tests/bugs/SL-104-SettledRuleClassCorpus.Tests.ps1 reads this file and the patterns from .taad/fitness.yaml; before is each row's hit count under the patterns of 824622e, before SL-104 (git show 824622e:.taad/fitness.yaml), where a row of the new Attributes entry had no pattern at all.
bounded_by: Who produces the members: a developer writing ordinary C# against System.IO in Core. That is every spelling the compiler accepts for the BCL member (a static, an instance, a method group, using static, a fully qualified name, each operator the property type defines) plus the Win32 and NT names Kernel32.cs declares. Not bounded in: reflection, nameof, delegates built from a using-static method group, dynamic, source generators and extension methods of other assemblies (System.IO.FileSystemAclExtensions): a text rule cannot see them and the because-texts say so.
